watering-can.label: Watering Can
watering-can.pivot: ground origin at the bounding-box centre; body axis 0.125 m behind it
watering-can.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
watering-can.notes: Galvanised can with a dark foot ring, a spout rising to a holed rose, and an iron carrying handle. 0.25 m across the body, 0.35 m tall. No blocking footprint is proposed; the spout and rose overhang the body.

wooden-bucket.label: Wooden Bucket
wooden-bucket.pivot: ground origin at the bucket's centre, on the body axis
wooden-bucket.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
wooden-bucket.notes: Eight oak staves in a one-voxel shell, a dark floor, two iron hoops, a little water in the top and a twine bail. 0.3 m across, 0.35 m tall to the rim, about 0.45 m with the bail. No blocking footprint is proposed.

wheelbarrow.label: Wheelbarrow
wheelbarrow.pivot: ground origin at the bounding-box centre; tray centre 0.125 m toward the handles
wheelbarrow.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
wheelbarrow.notes: Timber tray with an iron rim and a hay load, one wheel at -Y on an iron axle, and two handles at +Y. 0.45 m wide, 0.9 m long, 0.5 m tall. The footprint covers the whole barrow because the wheel and handle grips would block a walker.

clay-jug.label: Clay Jug
clay-jug.pivot: ground origin at the bounding-box centre; body axis 0.05 m toward -X
clay-jug.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
clay-jug.notes: Terracotta jug with a wide belly, a cream glazed shoulder, neck and lip, a dark throat and one loop handle on the +X side. 0.45 m across the belly, 0.5 m tall. No blocking footprint is proposed; the handle overhangs the belly.

notice-board.label: Notice Board
notice-board.pivot: ground origin at the bounding-box centre; posts 0 to 0.1 m behind it
notice-board.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
notice-board.notes: Framed timber board on two posts with a cream notice, teal pins and a violet tiled cap. 0.8 m wide board, 1.2 m tall with the cap. The footprint covers the posts and the board line; the cap overhangs it by about 0.05 m.

milk-churn.label: Milk Churn
milk-churn.pivot: ground origin on the body axis
milk-churn.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
milk-churn.notes: Tall galvanised churn on a dark iron foot, with two iron bands, a flared lid and a small arched iron handle on the lid. 0.4 m across the body, 0.8 m tall. The footprint is the body; the bands and lid rim overhang it by 0.03 to 0.05 m.
